description: This file defines the SugarFeedFlush class, providing a method to delete stale entries from the SugarFeed database table based on a date threshold, typically used in cleaning up old feed entries in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: SugarFeedFlush
classes.description: A class responsible for flushing stale entries in the SugarFeed module, specifically deleting old entries from the database.

methods.name: flushStaleEntries
methods.description: Deletes feed entries older than 14 days unless the current date matches the stored 'sugarfeed_flushdate' setting. It retrieves admin settings, checks date conditions, then executes a delete query on the SugarFeed table.
